# E012/E013 statistical integrity component

Imported from the portable package at
`atom-stack-store/e012-statistical-integrity-memory`
on 2026-11-14. Source project recorded by that package:
`quantum atom stacks experiments/experiments/e012`, source commit
`b65000b6cb2e60cdcf60e5edc6aec5db6271c027`.

The Rust source files match the SHA-256 values in the upstream package provenance. The app adapter uses the public
`axiom-engine` library without editing its mechanisms or tests. This is one
previously measured family and is not counted as a new stack discovery.

The rights holder offers this bundled copy under the MIT License. The Rust implementation is unchanged; the two crate manifests declare the license for this distribution.

The component's measured boundary is retained altered-byte evidence against
an externally trusted 160-record reference. It does not authenticate the
reference, prove freshness, identify an attacker, or enforce file protection.
